name: Camping Hochzillertal
beschreibung: The Camping Hochzillertal is located in Kaltenbach in the Zillertal and is classified as a campsite in the accommodation category. The facility is located directly at the foot of the mountain railway of the same name and is therefore a starting point for activities in both winter and summer. The site offers separate pitches for motorhomes, caravans, and tents with corresponding electricity and water supply. Sanitary facilities as well as a small shopping option are available on the grounds. In the surrounding area, you can use the Hochzillertal ski area or, in summer, numerous hiking routes.
